thread:
maria: Deploybot flagged a p50 latency spike on canary and suggested auto-revert. Can someone confirm whether we let it auto-rollback or suppress?

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATIC] Canary p50 > 350ms threshold breached (p50=410ms) for 6m. Suggested action: auto-revert to v2.13.9 unless suppressed. Reason: latency_regression

kevin: We're inside a change window but Dedicated pools are pinned to v2.14.0 for a customer. Auto-revert would only touch hosted. We shouldn't trigger infra-wide reverts without a manual check.

jess: +1. Also seeing a few 502s from edge in us-west, possibly related to kvcache hotpath.

maria: @kevin deploy-bot, how do we suppress auto-reverts for this rollout? Also, how do we communicate to customers / update release notes?

deploy-bot: To suppress auto-revert: run `rdwctl release hold --id=rel_2026_04_09 --suppress-auto-revert true` or add annotation `suppress_autorevert=true` to the rollout. For manual rollback, use:
```
rdwctl rollback --to-version=2.13.9 --scope=hosted --reason="latency spike"
```

kevin: I'm holding the auto-revert now.

kevin: `rdwctl release hold --id=rel_2026_04_09 --suppress-auto-revert true` -> OK

sam: On it. Opening a bridge with SRE to validate KV cache config across canary and prepping rollback playbook in case.

maria: Support, can you draft a short customer blurb that says we're investigating a hosted canary latency increase but that Dedicated pinned fleets are unaffected? Keep it neutral.

support-oncall: Draft: "We're investigating a latency increase observed in canary for the hosted API earlier today. Dedicated and pinned instances are unaffected. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes." Approve to send? :email:

jess: Approve. Also add troubleshooting note in release notes: `Known issue: transient kvcache invalidation may raise p50; workaround: restart worker pool`

kevin: Proposed decision thresholds: if error rate > 1% for 10m OR p50 > 400ms for 10m, execute manual revert of hosted to 2.13.9. Otherwise keep suppress flag and investigate. Agree?

maria: Agreed. I'll monitor metrics and call manual rollback if thresholds are met, tagging @kevin to execute.

sam: Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/xyz

maria: Update: canary p50 trending down to 360ms, error rate stable at 0.4%. Holding for 20 more minutes.

deploy-bot: [NOTE] Rollout annotation updated: suppress_autorevert=true by kevin at 2026-04-09T15:12Z

maria: Action items: 1) Support sends memo (support-oncall). 2) Kevin keeps suppress flag and stands by to run rollback. 3) Jess adds troubleshooting note to release notes. I'll update thread in 15m. :thumbsup:

kevin: Ready to run `rdwctl rollback --to-version=2.13.9 --scope=hosted` if needed. Ping me.

maria: Final update: metrics stabilized, no rollback executed. Releasing hold in 30m and publishing release notes update with the known issue blurb. Closing thread."
